review_notes: I reviewed the whole of the supplied text of halasz_log_phase_bound, lines 1–85. I did not open the imported files or any related sources. The proof splits on lam ≤ 48. In each branch it applies halasz_phase_from_polynomial and then compares constants with the shared target bound C*(lam+1)^6*N^(-1/(10^15*lam^2)). The two branches use different hypotheses and different polynomial lemmas (hR₁ in one, hR₂ and the large-degree selection in the other). Their constant comparisons also differ: one is (R₁+182)^6 ≤ C ≤ C(lam+1)^6, the other is (R₂+12m+32)^6 ≤ ((R+200)(lam+1))^6 via nlinarith. The only literally shared pieces are short: casting R₁ ≤ R or R₂ ≤ R, then pow_le_pow_left₀, and the positivity and norm_num side goals. These are routine calculations, so a shared lemma would not meet the rubric's threshold. Any extracted helper would mostly be a thin wrapper, and it would not make the file easier to read or maintain. I found no nontrivial reasoning repeated in two proofs.
